name: bento-grid
title: Bento Grid
description: A composable, responsive bento grid. Declare items with colSpan/rowSpan, add icons, titles, descriptions, or fully custom children. Stacks on mobile, full grid on desktop.
author: Wensity <hello@wensity.com>

theme.font-sans: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/bento-grid.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add bento-grid.
